# Building interactive data visualization with Animint2

This journal is the home for verified weekly progress, technical decisions, experiments, and lessons from Gaurav Chaudhary's GSoC 2026 work with Animint2 and the R Project.

::: {.hero-meta}
**Gaurav Chaudhary**<br>

## About the project

::: {.editorial-panel}
Animint2 extends the grammar of graphics with animated, linked, interactive visualizations for the web. This Quarto site is structured to document the work without inventing contributions: only verified outcomes, links, and project details will replace the starter entries.
:::
